fieldDescription: The successful missions amount required to increase contact's importance from High to Very High.
The successful missions amount required to increase contact's importance from Medium to High.
The successful missions amount required to increase contact's importance from Low to Medium.
The successful missions amount required to increase contact's importance from Very Low to Low.
Enable market size requirement for Very High and High importance. Doesn't affect anyone that already has those importance even with low market size (like Alviss).
Market size requirement for a contact to be able to rise to Very High importance.
Market size requirement for a contact to be able to rise to High importance.
Enable cooldown after a contact's importance has risen before missions from that same contact would count towards the next threshold.
